name: Sintokogio,Ltd.
summary: Sintokogio,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells foundry, surface treatment, casting, environmental, conveying, special machinery, and other equipment in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in electronic core materials and ceramics businesses. It also offers green sand and v-process molding, chemically bonded sand, and aluminium casting products; dust collection and fire prevention system, exhaust gas and water treatment products; powder treatment products and technologies; and force sensors.
